headline: This law names a post office building in Pekin, Illinois, after Lance Corporal Jordan S. Bastean.
what_it_does: It officially designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 514 Broadway Street in Pekin, Illinois, as the "Lance Corporal Jordan S. Bastean Post Office." The change is only a name. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules. Naming post offices after people is a common ceremonial way to honor them.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 24, 2018.
